in_marathi.name: Tarunraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Youthful, radiant king
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tarunraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tarunraj is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Tarun’ meaning young, youthful and ‘Raj’ meaning king. This name is often given to a boy who is believed to bring radiance and prosperity to the family. Tarunraj is also associated with the Hindu deity Indra, the king of gods, who is known for his youthful and energetic nature.
